title: Load and pre-process Sentinel-1 GRD IW dual-pol SAR scenes (VH+VV) with border clipping
description: Use Copernicus Sentinel-1 GRD Level-1 IW dual-polarization (VH and VV) SAR imagery. Use the Google Earth Engine-provided COPERNICUS/S1_GRD collection processed for thermal noise removal, radiometric calibration, and terrain correction. To reduce noise artefacts that can introduce false detections, clip a 500 m buffer off image borders before downstream detection workflows.

outputs.sar_scenes: Collection of pre-processed Sentinel-1 scenes (VH,VV) with borders clipped
